text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You came at the perfect time!
Hayahide-san, please lend us your wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...A consultation about your post-retirement second career?
You're only in junior high, right? That's far too—

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Only one win in two years. A graded race victory is nothing but a distant pipe dream.
I thought it might be better to give up sooner rather than later...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What to do is up to the client. But having more
information to judge with is always better. That is why
we must put our heads together right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, wait a moment.
I haven't agreed to take this on yet—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's simulate...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Having become a doctor with the hands of God,
you save patients day and night alongside your brilliant assistant!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Case verified. All that's left is Doctor's decision.
How would you like to proceed?

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I... No, I can't.
Taking responsibility for someone else's future is just...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I feel like we could go with a more upbeat vibe.
Alright, let's regroup—Take 2!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Put your athletic abilities to work as a tokusatsu stunt performer!
Bring dreams to children through hero show shoots!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Super Science Warrior: Cyber UMA...!
No evil caught in my glasses has ever prospered.
Prepare yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Why do I have to play the one who loses!
Besides, I want a job that's a bit more mature.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... So many requests...
Then let's change it up even more for Take 3...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The first words from the passionate reporter interviewing an athlete
who snapped a painful losing streak with a glorious victory were—

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahaha... Sorry.
I wonder what people usually ask at a time like this.
I have no idea. I've never experienced this before, you see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I've managed to completely freeze the room. How embarrassing.
Please give me a moment to think of a Take 4...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Royce-kun.
Would you mind letting me handle the next one?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—It was a race I entered thinking it was my last chance.
Even amid a streak of losses,
it was the one graded race I kept clinging to.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? Why... this race was...
The one I planned to run last...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Victory will be... mine...!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text: ......No way.

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"This race, of all races...
I refuse to give it up!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—It seems it wasn't true
that you had given up after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, you aren't the least bit convinced
about searching for an alternative path.

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the results aren't following because I'm just too weak.
Even if I keep clinging on like this, it'll surely..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(That girl was trapped by her inferiority complex too.
However—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...There was a girl I met during the summer training camp.
She overcame the inferiority of her losing streak
and showed tremendous growth.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I think that scream of yours earlier was born from the same thing. You... aren't done yet, probably.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Once your mind and body are aligned in the same direction, I'll be here to talk through whatever decision you make."

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...Hayahide-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Your expression is completely different after just a few hours.
Now that makes all the trial and error worth it.

text_block_list.name: Royce's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Alright, last three runs!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (When one truly believes in their own growth, the experience gained through trial and error tends to be vastly greater than usual—)

Watching over her junior who was fired up and vowing to make a comeback,
Biwa Hayahide incorporated a new element
into the growth theory she was constructing.
